bethe_landscape.model: ferromagnetic Ising model in a uniform-message reduction
bethe_landscape.scope: one-dimensional restriction of the Bethe normalizer expression to uniform cavity messages, not the full Bethe variational domain

hard_core_tree_transition.model: hard-core model on the infinite 3-regular tree
hard_core_tree_transition.threshold_meaning: uniqueness and local stability threshold of the translation-invariant tree recursion; not a universal finite-graph algorithmic threshold

provenance.description: Deterministic calculations used by the belief-propagation article figures.

spin_glass_convergence.model: random 3-regular +/-J Ising spin glass, 60 spins, beta*|J| = 2
spin_glass_convergence.note: damping lowers the residual monotonically but does not reach the tolerance; the run is a non-convergence demonstration, not a claim about all spin glasses
